Prior source identifies established St-Juste coverage work and Sturdivant as a possible special-teams successor; original Week 5 and Week 6 approved reconciliation scoped injury to his ST-only role.

Direct practice report names Kitan Oladapo among first team punt gunners, and records him downing a Whelan punt. Week 7 official gamebook independently confirms active Oladapo with 10 special-teams snaps only. This establishes distinct documented coverage depth, not observed replacement.

Club outside CB depth with Rock Ya-Sin behind Rakestraw; archived cases align to separate safety and outside corner roles.

Postgame ankle treatment for St. Brown; no in-game injury departure reported. Week 7 gamebook and team recap show normal role and no reported removal.

Approved Week 5 frozen zero for Harper and continuing reserve/camp disposition classifications.
